Naomi / team,

Initial findings from the log pull and routing telemetry:

- Impact window (observed): 2028-06-18T08:31:54-07:00 to 2028-06-18T08:50:03-07:00 (18m 9s) for route /v1/pay/validate in us-west-2. Error rate spike to 6.8% 5xx (baseline ~0.02%).
- Root cause (short): an autoscaler race during a short control-plane rollout caused a transient mismatch between routing tables and available serving capacity; requests were routed to a limited fallback pool with lower instance count and a quantized model variant that has higher token processing time. In short: routing fallback + capacity mismatch.
- Evidence: infra_extracted_window_0618.json and logs_20280618.zip attached.

SLO / credit assessment: the production availability SLO (99.95%) is measured per-month and per-region. ZenithPay's observed downtime window exceeds the incident threshold for an SLA remedy. Per Section 4.2 of the contract (Uptime & Remedies) this qualifies as an SLA incident. Recommended remedy: pro-rata credit for the affected minute range. For a quick external figure: this maps roughly to a 10% credit on the June hosted usage invoice for the affected route (estimate subject to accounting verification).

Next steps: I'll draft a one-page interim RCA for Naomi to share with Zenith and schedule a follow-up postmortem.

Dylan
Principal Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference

Jake — thanks for your patience. Summary and next steps below: 

1) Confirmed impact window: 2028-06-18T08:31:54-07:00 to 2028-06-18T08:50:03-07:00 (18m 9s). We correlated your IDs (0a3f7c, 0a3f8d) and verified the traces that show retries and fallback.

2) Root cause (interim): a control-plane rollout triggered an autoscaler race which briefly left routing tables pointing to a reduced fallback pool (lower instance count + a quantized model variant). This produced elevated 5xxs and higher tail latency.

3) Credit eligibility: per Section 4.2 your account is eligible for an SLA remedy. Our recommended remediation is a pro-rata credit equivalent to ~10% of June hosted usage for the affected route (this is an interim estimate; accounting will compute the precise pro-rata amount).

4) Postmortem: we published the interim RCA and a proposed corrective action plan here: https://postmortems.redwood.company/znp-0618-routing-fallback (postmortem-20280620.md attached). The PM includes timeline, root cause, and action items (safety checks for rollout + routing table reconciliation and extra canary windows).

Please confirm whether the proposed credit is acceptable to ZenithPay and whether you need any additional artifacts (raw traces, pcap). Once you confirm acceptance we'll route the credit through billing and share the accounting statement.

Apologies for the disruption — we're treating this as a high-priority corrective item.

Best regards,
